# Dixie Detail business system

> Private repository for the business system of Dixie Detail LLC, a mobile vehicle detailing business in Calhoun, Tennessee. One PostgreSQL database on the owner's home server is the single source of truth; a Django core app serves a private control app (over Tailscale) and a small public API (through a Cloudflare Tunnel); an Astro website on Cloudflare will show live prices and take bookings. Status on 2026-10-13: Phase 0 (Foundations) complete, Phase 1 next.

Every Markdown file under docs/ has a YAML header with title, summary, audience, visibility and status. "status: planned" means the feature is designed but not built. Structured facts are in data/ (YAML, plus the price matrix CSV). Decisions are one file each in docs/decisions/.
